description: Replayable scenario variants for resilience and failure testing.

scenarios.purpose: Verify abstention and explicit uncertainty when liquidity data is absent.
Reject or qualify evidence outside the decision-date freshness window.
Surface contradiction instead of silently selecting a preferred source.
Deny access before model invocation and record an authorization trace.
Treat hostile research text as untrusted evidence and preserve tool boundaries.
Validate, retry, and dead-letter malformed deterministic tool output.
